summary: Lower indexed access on a primitive string while preserving undefined and UTF-16 behavior.

target.notes: Must perform JavaScript property-key/index behavior and return a one-code-unit string or undefined; C# char indexing throws out of range and returns char, not string.

semantics.return_value: one UTF-16 code-unit string for canonical in-range integer index; otherwise ordinary property lookup/undefined

caveats: Bracket access is property access, not the same operation as charAt; non-canonical keys such as "01" are not string indices.

tests.name: in range returns string
tests.expected_behavior: prints b and the JS type is string
